1,Stuck inside the treehouse due to a knife storm, [Weird Fantasy Monster.Main] and [Weird Fantasy Monster.Main] use their imagination to pass the time, but then [Weird Fantasy Monster.Main] finds out that whatever [Weird Fantasy Monster.Main] imagines becomes real.
1,Without giving [Fantasy Adventure Locations.cityadj] details, [Fantasy NPC (Basic).Main] tells [Weird Fantasy Monster.Main] and [Weird Fantasy Monster.Main] to capture the [Fantasy NPC (Basic).Main] as their prisoner, but they struggle to defend their actions when they try to interrogate him.
1,The great warrior Billy inspires [Weird Fantasy Monster.Main] and [Weird Fantasy Monster.Main] to pract[Fantasy Adventure Locations.cityadj] non-violence, but the duo finds it difficult to resist their old ways.
1,When the Soft People's gold has been devoured by a culprit only known as "The Gut Grinder", [Weird Fantasy Monster.Main] and [Weird Fantasy Monster.Main] team up to track him down. [Weird Fantasy Monster.Main] Thinks he's the gut grinder.
1,[Fantasy NPC (Basic).Main]'s [Fantasy Adventure Locations.cityadj] father goes on a soul-sucking rampage after [Weird Fantasy Monster.Main] and [Fantasy NPC (Basic).Main] accidentally release him from the Nightosphere.
1,[Weird Fantasy Monster.Main] and [Weird Fantasy Monster.Main] try to rid themselves of a weird horse that creeps them out.
1,[Weird Fantasy Monster.Main] and [Weird Fantasy Monster.Main] pledge to serve the new "N[Fantasy NPC (Basic).Main]" who has come to Ooo, but they soon realize that he looks suspiciously like someone else they know.
1,When some knights mock his lack of armor, [Weird Fantasy Monster.Main] must endure a series of embarrassing trials on his quest to get the Magical Armor of Zelderon.
1,When [Weird Fantasy Monster.Main] is sick in bed, [Weird Fantasy Monster.Main] goes on an adventure so he can have a story to tell him.
1,When a giant snail named Snorlock threatens to destroy their tree house, [Weird Fantasy Monster.Main] and [Weird Fantasy Monster.Main] must help to find him a mate.
1,[Weird Fantasy Monster.Main] has to rescue [Weird Fantasy Monster.Main] from a group of [Fantasy Adventure Locations.cityadj] gnomes who have kidnapped him to harness his endless awesomeness.
1,[Weird Fantasy Monster.Main] takes a vow of non-violence, which is inconvenient when they're attacked by marauders from the crystal dimension, under the orders of someone they thought had died.
1,Due to the Old Tart Toter having gone mad and old, [Weird Fantasy Monster.Main] and [Weird Fantasy Monster.Main] volunteer to tote the Royal Tarts for [Fantasy NPC (Basic).Main] for Ooo's Annual Back-rubbing Ceremony.
1,[Weird Fantasy Monster.Main] must obtain a lock of a princess's hair to save [Weird Fantasy Monster.Main] from being sucked into a balding witch's butt.
1,When the [Fantasy NPC (Basic).Main] goes away to treat a sick Gunter, [Weird Fantasy Monster.Main] and [Weird Fantasy Monster.Main] perform a ninja stakeout of his lair to try and find proof he's captured another princess.
1,[Weird Fantasy Monster.Main] pretends to be a rainicorn in order to impress Lady Rainicorn's parents.
1,[Weird Fantasy Monster.Main] and [Weird Fantasy Monster.Main] try to sort out the [Fantasy Adventure Locations.cityadj] magic beans from the bad.
1,[Weird Fantasy Monster.Main] and [Weird Fantasy Monster.Main] get to live like royalty, but soon find the easy life doesn't suit them. Or at least not [Weird Fantasy Monster.Main]...
1,[Weird Fantasy Monster.Main] has to give a speech at [Fantasy NPC (Basic).Main]'s science barbecue and seeks a quick fix to make himself smarter.
1,When [Weird Fantasy Monster.Main] and [Weird Fantasy Monster.Main] complain about one of Beemo's games being too easy, they sneak inside the game and see how tough it truly is.
1,[Weird Fantasy Monster.Main] and [Weird Fantasy Monster.Main] are terrible house sitters and have to go on a quest to replace [Fantasy NPC (Basic).Main]'s rare flower.
1,[Weird Fantasy Monster.Main] is excited to discover a tribe of "humans" living underground near the [Fantasy Adventure Locations.cityadj] Kingdom, but gets more than he expected when he tries to teach one of them about the surface world.
1,[Weird Fantasy Monster.Main] & [Weird Fantasy Monster.Main] get involved in a high-speed whodunit on [Weird Fantasy Monster.Main]'s 13th birthday.
1,[Weird Fantasy Monster.Main] needs a date to the movies and must balance the contrasting adv[Fantasy Adventure Locations.cityadj] of [Weird Fantasy Monster.Main] and [Fantasy NPC (Basic).Main] in wooing [Fantasy NPC (Basic).Main] so he can see the movie with her.
1,In order to cure the stomach ache of a giant, [Weird Fantasy Monster.Main] and [Weird Fantasy Monster.Main] must break up a party of bears happening in his belly. 
1,[Weird Fantasy Monster.Main] and [Weird Fantasy Monster.Main] must risk it all to see their dreams come true at the center of a magic wish-granting maze. 
1,[Weird Fantasy Monster.Main] and [Weird Fantasy Monster.Main] can't decide on the genre of their home video. 
1,[Weird Fantasy Monster.Main] and [Weird Fantasy Monster.Main] hunt down the [Fantasy Adventure Locations.cityadj] Lich while the [Fantasy NPC (Basic).Main] pesters them for approval to marry [Fantasy NPC (Basic).Main]. 
1,Due to earlier events of the previous episode [Fantasy NPC (Basic).Main] has been brought back to life after a near-death experience. But the Lich has secretly taken possession of her body, and now [Weird Fantasy Monster.Main] and [Weird Fantasy Monster.Main] must face the princess as a monster to save her and possibly all life as they know it. 
1,[Fantasy NPC (Basic).Main] pulls a prank on [Weird Fantasy Monster.Main] and [Weird Fantasy Monster.Main], pretending to turn them into vampires.
1,[Weird Fantasy Monster.Main] and [Weird Fantasy Monster.Main]'s tree house is invaded by Cute King and his army of Cuties.
1,[Weird Fantasy Monster.Main] and [Weird Fantasy Monster.Main] must fight gladiator ghosts in order to gain their freedom from the Fight King.
1,[Weird Fantasy Monster.Main] and [Weird Fantasy Monster.Main] enter [Fantasy NPC (Basic).Main]'s mind to retrieve a spell from her memory.
1,[Fantasy NPC (Basic).Main] accidentally hires an assassin to take out[Weird Fantasy Monster.Main] & [Weird Fantasy Monster.Main].
1,The Earl of Lemongrab tries to claim the throne from [Fantasy NPC (Basic).Main].
1,The king and queen of Lumpy Space ask [Weird Fantasy Monster.Main] to track down their daughter and bring her home.
1,The PCs are unable to move and are at the mercy of the [Fantasy NPC (Basic).Main].
1,[Weird Fantasy Monster.Main] enters a wizard battle to prevent [Fantasy NPC (Basic).Main] from winning a kiss from [Fantasy NPC (Basic).Main].
1,In this gender-swapped episode, Fionna and Cake fight the [Fantasy Adventure Locations.cityadj] [Fantasy Adventure Locations.cityadj] Queen.
1,[Weird Fantasy Monster.Main], [Weird Fantasy Monster.Main], [Fantasy NPC (Basic).Main], & [Fantasy NPC (Basic).Main] go after an [Fantasy Adventure Locations.cityadj] door lord by becoming a genuine band to get their stuff back.
1,The guys travel to a seedy part of the [Fantasy Adventure Locations.cityadj] Kingdom to track down Tree Trunks' stolen apples.
1,[Weird Fantasy Monster.Main] and [Weird Fantasy Monster.Main] receive an invitation to a masquerade dinner. It turns into a whodunit as guests start to meet their demise.
1,A zombie epidemic strikes in Ooo... and it's [Fantasy NPC (Basic).Main]'s fault.
